source: LRO LOLA 5 m/px south-polar DEM mosaic (ldem_87s_5mpp), Barker et al. 2021, NASA PGDA — downsampled to 40 m for the far-field skirt
format: horizon.bin: 251x251 Float32 LE, row-major, row 0 = north, col 0 = west, Z metres MOON_ME. Same origin as heightmap.bin.
curvature_note: Runtime applies spherical drop d^2/(2R) for a true horizon.
